# Every terminal gets its own worktree; closing asks Delete / Keep (KAN-100)

## What to build

A terminal opened on a workspace gets its own git worktree at `<workspace>/.gm-worktrees/<terminal-id>` on a new branch `gm-term/<terminal-id>`, cut from the workspace's HEAD. The PTY starts in that folder. Closing a terminal without work removes the worktree and branch; closing one with work answers 409 and the UI asks **Delete / Keep / Create PR / Cancel** (Create PR is wired up by a later task; here the button may be present but disabled with the title "coming" only if that task is not done — implement Delete and Keep fully). Kept worktrees are stored and listed under their workspace with **Open terminal** and **Delete**. The spec is `docs/prd/done/isolated-workspaces.md`; read its Decisions and Requirements sections for this slice.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/terminals.ts` (lines 43–112) — `POST /api/terminals` (cwd = `ws.path` today) and `DELETE /api/terminals/:id`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.ts` (lines 1–120) — `TerminalInfo`, `CreateTerminal`, `TerminalManager`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts` (lines 20–60) — zod store schema with `.default({})` records; mirror `prs`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/pr.ts` (the `git()` helper, `gitEnv`) — how git is called with `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Terminals.tsx`, `pages/TerminalPane.tsx` (header at ~line 200), `ui/Dialog.tsx` — the page, the pane header and the dialog component.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/terminals.test.ts` — route test pattern (real git repos in temp folders via `test-helpers.ts`).

## Step-by-step tasks

### ADD `apps/graph-manager/src/server/worktrees.ts`
- `WORKTREES_DIR = ".gm-worktrees"`; `ensureExcluded(wsPath)` appends `.gm-worktrees/` to `.git/info/exclude` once; `addTerminalWorktree(wsPath, id)` → `git worktree add -b gm-term/<id> <path> HEAD`, returns `{ path, branch, base (HEAD sha), baseBranch? }`; `worktreeState(path, base)` → `{ dirty: git status --porcelain non-empty, ahead: git rev-list --count <base>..HEAD }`; `removeWorktree(wsPath, path, { deleteBranch?: string })` → `git worktree remove --force` then `git branch -D`; `tempWorktree(wsPath, ref, name)` → `git worktree add --detach` under `.gm-worktrees/<name>` returning a `dispose()`.
- **GOTCHA**: never put worktrees under `.graph-execution/` (the engine refuses to run there). Use `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` and `reject: false`.

### UPDATE `store.ts`
- `terminalWorktrees: z.record(z.string(), z.object({ workspaceId, path, branch, base, baseBranch: optional, title, createdAt, kept: z.boolean().optional() })).default({})`.

### UPDATE `terminals.ts` and `routes/terminals.ts`
- `TerminalInfo.worktree?: { path: string; branch: string }`. `POST` with `workspaceId`: create the worktree, save the record, `cwd` = worktree. Projects / plain cwd: unchanged. The `project-config` agent preparation still targets the workspace.
- `DELETE /api/terminals/:id`: with a worktree that has work and no `worktree` query → 409 `{ error: "the terminal has work", needsChoice: true, dirty, ahead, branch }`, terminal stays open. No work → close, remove worktree and branch, delete record, 204. `?worktree=delete` → remove both; `?worktree=keep` → `kept: true`; both close the terminal, 204.
- `GET /api/workspaces/:id/worktrees` → `{ worktrees: [{ id, path, branch, title, createdAt, dirty, ahead }] }` (kept only). `POST /api/workspaces/:id/worktrees/:wid/terminal` opens a terminal in it (record moves to the new terminal id, `kept` cleared). `DELETE /api/workspaces/:id/worktrees/:wid` removes it, 204; 404 for unknown ids.

### UPDATE web
- Pane header shows the branch. Close → on 409 `needsChoice` open a `Dialog`: "<branch> has <N uncommitted files / M commits>." with Delete, Keep, Create PR, Cancel (`data-testid`s `close-delete`, `close-keep`, `close-pr`). Each workspace section lists kept worktrees (`data-testid="kept-worktree"`) with Open terminal and Delete (confirm).

### ADD tests
- `routes/terminals.test.ts`: create → `worktree.branch` and folder exist; untouched close → 204 and folder/branch gone; changed file → 409 needsChoice; `?worktree=keep` → listed; DELETE kept → gone.
- A web test for the close dialog in `Terminals` tests.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `POST /api/terminals { workspaceId }` returns `worktree.branch = gm-term/<id>` and the PTY's cwd is the worktree.
- [ ] Close behaviour as above, including 409 `needsChoice`.
- [ ] Kept worktrees survive a server restart (stored) and can be reopened or deleted.
- [ ] `npm test -w graph-manager` passes.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager -- terminals worktrees
```
